title: Phase 7 (Minimal): Basic global error toasts (top-right, gold border, pearl text, 4s fade)

requirements.text: Implement a minimal, reusable error-toast helper that shows a top-right toast for errors with: (1) gold border, (2) pearl off-white text color #F5F5F0, and (3) automatic fade-out after 4 seconds. Use English text and a default message format like "Error: Please try again".

quotes: Add basic error toasts: - On any error (invalid OTP, save fail, network) show top-right toast: - Gold border, pearl off-white text (#F5F5F0) - Message example: "Error: Please try again" - Fade out after 4 seconds

acceptanceCriteria: Triggering the helper displays a toast in the top-right corner (existing Toaster placement is preserved).
Toast text color is exactly #F5F5F0 and the toast has a gold border.
Toast fades out and is fully dismissed after ~4 seconds.

requirements.text: Wire the new basic error toast into existing error paths without changing routing/auth flow/UI layout: show the toast on invalid OTP entry, OTP send/verify failures, Internet Identity login failures, and dashboard profile save failures (including network/actor errors).

quotes: On any error (invalid OTP, save fail, network) show top-right toast
Do NOT change routing, auth flow, or add new components.

acceptanceCriteria: Entering a wrong OTP triggers the error toast.
Forcing a profile save failure (e.g., actor/network failure) triggers the error toast.
Existing pages (login/dashboard/admin/storefront) remain visually stable with no layout shifts introduced by the change.

requirements.text: Keep the change minimal: do not add a notification bell, do not implement rate limiting, and do not add heavy logic. Preserve the existing theme, hover effects, and dashboard layout; do not change SPA routing or authentication flow.

quotes: No notification bell, no rate limiting, no heavy logic.
Keep existing theme, hovers, dashboard layout.
Do NOT change routing, auth flow, or add new components.

acceptanceCriteria: No new notification/bell UI is present anywhere.
Navigation/routing behavior remains identical to the current reverted working version.

requirements.text: After implementing and deploying the update, provide the draft URL and confirm via a short checklist: (1) no blank screen on login, (2) error toast is visible when triggered (wrong OTP or failed save), and (3) UI is stable.

quotes: After update: - Give draft URL. - Confirm: - No blank screen on login. - Error toast visible when triggered (test with wrong OTP or failed save). - UI stable.

acceptanceCriteria: A draft URL is provided after deployment.
Confirmation explicitly states: no blank screen on login; toast visible on wrong OTP and failed save; UI stable.

constraints: Do not change SPA routing, route paths, or navigation behavior.
Do not change the authentication flow logic (OTP flow and Internet Identity flow must remain functionally the same).
Do not add new UI components (compose existing infrastructure/utilities only).
Preserve existing theme tokens, hover effects, and dashboard layout.

Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui/*.
nonGoals: Notification bell or any notification center UI.
Rate limiting / throttling / lockout logic beyond what already exists.
Any backend changes or schema migrations.
